conceptual assets.concept: DMEM contents — bytes stored in on-chip data arrays
conceptual assets.reasoning: The mem_access process conditionally updates the byte arrays: e.g. `mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0);` when `(bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1')` and `bus_req_i.ben(n) = '1'`; reads also source these arrays into rdata (`rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr));` etc). These mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 arrays therefore realize the persistent DMEM contents whose correct storage (write/retain/readback) is required by the RTL flows.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-data staging (rdata) — the word produced from DMEM for the bus
conceptual assets.reasoning: rdata is assigned from the memory byte arrays (`rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr));` ... or in the alt style from `addr_ff`) and is the internal value driven to the bus: `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')`. rdata therefore realizes the read word presented by the module; its correctness is required for correct read responses.

conceptual assets.concept: Address index (addr) — memory index derived from the bus address
conceptual assets.reasoning: The concurrent assignment `addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2));` computes the index used to address the memory (`to_integer(addr)` is used to index mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 in reads and writes). Correct computation of addr is required so reads and writes target the intended memory locations.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-enable decision (rden) — clocked gating that enables read-data output
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process sets `rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)` on the rising clock edge (reset clears it). rden gates the response data (`bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0')`), so correctness of rden determines whether the module presents stored read data or zeros as the bus response.
